name: Rembric
description: Self-hosted memory, sessions, and dashboard for AI coding agents. Native OpenClaw memory provider.

server_url.label: Rembric Server URL
server_url.help: Base URL of your Rembric deployment WITHOUT the /mcp suffix. No trailing slash.

api_token.label: Rembric API Token
api_token.help: Bearer token issued from the Rembric dashboard at /dashboard/tokens (plaintext shown exactly once).

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Inject relevant Rembric memories into every prompt before the agent runs.

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically save observations from completed turns. Off by default — Rembric's topic_key + judgment model expects explicit memory_save calls.

tokenBudget.label: Token Budget
tokenBudget.help: Approximate token budget for the auto-recall context block injected on each turn.
